planning_notes: Board is fixed to arduino:avr:uno and uses authoritative wiring endpoints: A1 (LM35), D2 (vibration), D3 (door magnet), D4/D5 (TM1637 CLK/DIO), D6 (buzzer), D13 (alarm LED).

Serial transmit reporting uses serial_channels only; serial receive for the stated GPS 模拟数据通过串口输入 is added via a serial_integer_input because outgoing serial_channels cannot satisfy serial receive requirements.

LM35 is modeled as analog_input on A1 without fabricated electrical calibration (no scale/offset specified). Temperature thresholding, anomaly counting, and round-robin display logic belong in the SysML model.
Vibration and door magnet are modeled as digital_input with initial false; active_high/pullup polarity is not specified in the requirement, so no interface-layer override is applied.
TM1637 is configured for a numeric value only; display formatting and round-robin between temperature and abnormal count belong in the SysML model.
Immediate alarm and serial event logging behavior belongs in SysML; this interface proposal only declares physical ports and serial reporting types.

GPS receive parsing (tokenization/baud framing details beyond baud, and mapping to 'position' used in event logs) is handled in SysML using the received integer value; interface-level constraints only guarantee a valid numeric receive event per control step.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: LM35 temperature sensing input (cold-chain box monitoring)

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: Vibration sensor input for counting severe events

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: Door magnet switch input for detecting opening events

interfaces.name: io_3
interfaces.meaning: TM1637 display number (round-robin: current temperature / abnormal count)

interfaces.name: io_6
interfaces.meaning: GPS 模拟数据通过串口输入（数值接收；具体含义/取值范围由 SysML 解释与解析）

interfaces.name: io_6_valid
interfaces.meaning: True for this model step only when a complete valid serial frame was received; value holds its previous value otherwise

interfaces.name: serial_0_trigger
interfaces.meaning: Business report gate for emitting event logs and position-tagged messages when alarm/open/vibration/temperature abnormal conditions occur

interfaces.name: serial_0_value_0
interfaces.meaning: Reported temperature value used in alarm/event logs

interfaces.name: serial_0_value_1
interfaces.meaning: Reported abnormal/open/vibration-related counter value used in event logs

configuration_resolution.original_requirement: 实现一个药品冷链运输箱监测系统，使用温度传感器 LM35（A1）、震动传感器 D2、门磁 D3、GPS 模拟数据通过串口输入、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）、蜂鸣器 D6 和 LED D13。系统记录温度异常、开箱事件和剧烈震动次数，轮流显示当前温度和异常计数；一旦温度超过上限或运输过程中开箱，则立即报警并串口输出带位置的事件日志。
